snippet.title: Hellforged | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

Wishlist Hellforged now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4554250/Hellforged/
Join us on socials
X: https://x.com/Hellforged_game
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@hellforged_game
